instruction: Please recreate this diagram in PowerPoint (it must remain editable in PowerPoint) and center it on a single slide without changing its aspect ratio.

dim1: The deliverable is in .ppt or .pptx format and opens normally.
The delivered PowerPoint contains only 1 slide.

All visible elements on slide 1 are editable objects. The background, outer border, text, dashed rounded rectangles, arrows, connector lines, electrode shapes, beaker shape, instrument shape, computer shape, legend box, icons, and curves on the slide can each be selected and edited separately; the entire slide must not be a single non-editable image.
Slide 1 uses a landscape 16:9 aspect ratio, and the slide content has not been stretched, compressed, rotated, or cropped as a whole.
Slide 1 does not have more than 50% blank area, large-scale text overlap, objects extending beyond the slide boundaries, or content that is unreadable because elements obscure it.
dim2: +1: White background on slide 1: covers the entire slide, with a white or very light gray-white fill; the slide has no unrelated texture, photographic background, or full-slide watermark.

+1: Outer blue rectangular border on slide 1: positioned along all four edges of the slide, within 0cm–0.2cm of the left, right, top, and bottom slide edges; it is a single solid rectangular border in medium blue with a line width of 1.5 pt–2.5 pt.

+1: Outline of the beaker on the left of slide 1: positioned within 4.5cm–11.3cm from the left and 7cm–13.9cm from the top. The overall shape is a transparent beaker with a wider opening at the top and a narrower bottom, including an elliptical top rim, slanted left and right walls, and a curved bottom. It has no fill or a very light blue transparent effect, with a light gray-blue single solid outline 1 pt–1.8 pt wide.

+1: Elliptical opening at the top of the left beaker on slide 1: positioned in the upper portion of the beaker, within 3.0cm–10.5cm from the left and 7.2cm–8.5cm from the top; it is a horizontally flattened ellipse with a light gray-blue single solid outline 0.75 pt–1.25 pt wide.

+3: Liquid surface and liquid fill inside the left beaker on slide 1: positioned in the middle-lower portion of the beaker, within 4.5cm–11cm from the left and 9cm–14cm from the top. The liquid has a semi-transparent light blue or pale cyan-blue fill, the upper liquid surface is a light blue elliptical arc, and multiple pale white or pale blue-white circular bubbles are visible in the liquid area.

+1: Text at the bottom of the left beaker on slide 1: positioned at the lower center inside the beaker, within 6.4cm–9cm from the left and 12cm–13.5cm from the top. The text reads “Sample Solution,” uses SimHei, Microsoft YaHei, or a similar Chinese font at 14 pt–16 pt, is black or dark gray, and is horizontally centered.

+3: Green reference electrode on the left of slide 1: positioned inside the left side of the beaker, within 4cm–6.5cm from the left and 6.0cm–11.5cm from the top. It is a slender electrode tilted to the left, with a light-to-dark green body, a green connector at the top, and its lower end immersed in the liquid; it has a green single solid outline 0.75 pt–1.25 pt wide.

+3: White-and-blue working electrode in the middle-left of slide 1: positioned above the center of the beaker, within 7.2cm–8.5cm from the left and 3.6cm–12.3cm from the top. It is a nearly vertical electrode with a dark blue-black cylindrical head at the top, a black retaining ring, white shaft, and light blue transparent sleeve in the middle, and a lower end immersed in the liquid; it has a dark gray or black single solid outline 0.5 pt–1.25 pt wide.

+3: Red counter electrode on the right of slide 1: positioned inside the right side of the beaker, within 8.5cm–10.5cm from the left and 6.5cm–11.5cm from the top. It is a slender electrode tilted to the right, with a red-to-dark-red body, a red connector at the top, and its lower end immersed in the liquid; it has a red single solid outline 0.5 pt–1.25 pt wide.

+1: “Reference Electrode” text on the left of slide 1: positioned to the left of the beaker, within 2cm–4.4cm from the left and 9.2cm–10.4cm from the top. The text reads “Reference Electrode,” uses SimHei, Microsoft YaHei, or a similar Chinese font at 13 pt–15 pt, and is black or dark gray. Between the right side of the “Reference Electrode” text and the green reference electrode, within 4.2cm–6.2cm from the left and 9.4cm–9.8cm from the top, there is a black horizontal single-headed arrow 1.4-1.6cm long and 1 pt–1.5 pt wide, pointing right, with its tip pointing toward the green reference electrode.

+1: “Working Electrode” text in the middle of slide 1: positioned slightly above the center of the beaker, within 6.4cm–9.2cm from the left and 9cm–10.0cm from the top. The text reads “Working Electrode,” uses SimHei, Microsoft YaHei, or a similar Chinese font at 14 pt–16 pt, is black or dark gray, and is horizontally centered.

+1: “Counter Electrode” text on the right of slide 1: positioned to the right of the beaker, within 10.5cm–12.7cm from the left and 9.1cm–10.3cm from the top. The text reads “Counter Electrode,” uses SimHei, Microsoft YaHei, or a similar Chinese font at 14 pt–16 pt, and is black or dark gray. Between the left side of the “Counter Electrode” text and the red counter electrode, within 9.2cm–11.2cm from the left and 9.4cm–9.9cm from the top, there is a black horizontal single-headed arrow 1.4-1.6cm long and 1 pt–1.5 pt wide, pointing right, with its tip pointing toward the red counter electrode.

+1: “Analyte Input” text at the top of slide 1: positioned above the top of the working electrode, within 7cm–10.3cm from the left and 1.0cm–1.8cm from the top. The text reads “Analyte Input,” uses SimHei, Microsoft YaHei, or a similar Chinese font at 14-16 pt, and is blue. Below the “Analyte Input” text and above the top of the working electrode, within 7.2cm–8.4cm from the left and 1.5cm–3.8cm from the top, there is a blue vertical dashed single-headed arrow 1 pt–1.5 pt wide, pointing downward, with its tip pointing toward the top of the working electrode.

+3: Green reference-electrode connector line on slide 1: starts at the top of the green reference electrode and ends at the upper-left or rear-left side of the instrument in the middle. It lies overall within 3.5cm–14.7cm from the left and 5.2cm–10cm from the top and is a green curved single solid line 1.5 pt–2.5 pt wide. Black working-electrode connector line: starts at the top of the working electrode and ends at the upper-left or rear-left side of the instrument in the middle. It lies overall within 7.5cm–16.4cm from the left and 3.0cm–10.0cm from the top and is a black curved single solid line 1.5 pt–2.5 pt wide. Red counter-electrode connector line: starts at the top of the red counter electrode and ends at the upper-left or rear-left side of the instrument in the middle. It lies overall within 9.5cm–15.5cm from the left and 5.2cm–10cm from the top and is a red curved single solid line 1.5 pt–2.5 pt wide.

+5: Housing of the electrochemical analyzer in the middle of slide 1: positioned within 13.0cm–22.0cm from the left and 8.5cm–12.5cm from the top. It is a rectangular-prism instrument with a perspective effect; the front panel is blue, the top and side surfaces of the housing have a light gray-blue to gray-white gradient, and the bottom has a dark base shadow. It has a dark blue or gray-blue single solid outline 0.75 pt–1.25 pt wide.

+3: Front display of the electrochemical analyzer in the middle of slide 1: positioned on the left side of the instrument's front panel, within 13.2cm–16cm from the left and 10cm–12cm from the top. It is a blue rectangular display with a white or light gray-white border, containing white coordinate axes and a white line-chart icon. The display has a white or light-colored single solid outline 0.75 pt–1.25 pt wide.

+1: Name text of the electrochemical analyzer in the middle of slide 1: positioned in the middle of the instrument's front panel, within 15.4cm–18.8cm from the left and 10.5cm–11.5cm from the top. The text reads “Electrochemical Analyzer,” uses SimHei, Microsoft YaHei, or a similar Chinese font at 12-14 pt, and is light cyan-blue or white-blue.

+1: Indicator-light group of the electrochemical analyzer in the middle of slide 1: positioned on the right side of the instrument's front panel, within 18.5-19.5cm from the left and 10cm–12cm from the top. It contains three small circular lights arranged vertically; the top, middle, and bottom lights are green, blue, and red, respectively, and each dot has a diameter of 0.15cm–0.28cm.

+1: Upper dashed box in the middle of slide 1: positioned above the instrument, within 16.3cm–21.7cm from the left and 6cm-7.5cm from the top. It is a blue dashed rounded rectangle 1 pt–1.5 pt wide, with a white fill or no fill, 4.8cm-5.2cm wide and 1.2cm-1.6cm high. The text inside reads “Signal Acquisition and Processing,” uses SimHei, Microsoft YaHei, or a similar Chinese font at 14-16 pt, and is dark blue. Below the “Signal Acquisition and Processing” dashed box and above the top surface of the instrument, within 18cm–19cm from the left and 7.3cm–9cm from the top, there is a blue vertical dashed single-headed arrow 1 pt–1.5 pt wide, pointing downward, with its tip pointing toward the top surface of the instrument.

+1: Lower dashed box in the middle of slide 1: positioned below the instrument, within 14.4cm–19.4cm from the left and 13.1cm–15cm from the top. It is a blue dashed rounded rectangle 1 pt–1.5 pt wide, with a white fill or no fill, 4.2cm-4.7cm wide and 1.3cm-1.7cm high. The text inside reads “Potential/Current Control,” uses SimHei, Microsoft YaHei, or a similar Chinese font at 14-16 pt, and is dark blue. Above the “Potential/Current Control” dashed box and between it and the bottom edge of the instrument's front panel, within 16.2cm–17.4cm from the left and 12cm–13.5cm from the top, there is a blue vertical dashed single-headed arrow 1 pt–1.5 pt wide, pointing upward, with its tip pointing toward the instrument's front panel.

+1: Connector line on the middle-right of slide 1: starts at the right side of the electrochemical analyzer and ends at the left-side port of the laptop on the right. It lies overall within 21.2cm–24.8cm from the left and 9.8cm-11cm from the top and is a black curved or nearly horizontal single solid line 1.5 pt–2.5 pt wide.

+5: Outer contour of the laptop on the right of slide 1: positioned within 22.5cm–32cm from the left and 6.2cm–12.5cm from the top. It is an open laptop that includes a screen, keyboard base, and rear folding hinge; the body is dark blue, dark gray-blue, or blue-black, with a dark blue or black single solid outline 0.75 pt–1.25 pt wide.

+5: Screen area of the laptop on the right of slide 1: positioned in the upper half of the laptop, within 22.5cm–31.8cm from the left and 6.4cm–11cm from the top. The screen has a white or very light gray-white fill and a dark blue border, with a light gray interface bar and small circular decorations at the top of the screen. On the left half of the screen, within 25.0cm–28cm from the left and 7.3cm–10.5cm from the top, there is a blue line chart containing light gray coordinate axes and a blue curve, with a line width of 0.75 pt–1.25 pt. On the right half of the screen, within 27.8cm–30.2cm from the left and 7.3cm–10.5cm from the top, there is a red distribution curve chart containing light gray coordinate axes and a red curve, with a line width of 0.75 pt–1.25 pt.

+1: Text below the laptop on the right of slide 1: positioned centrally below the laptop, within 25.0cm–27.4cm from the left and 12.4cm–13.8cm from the top. The text reads “Computer,” uses SimHei, Microsoft YaHei, or a similar Chinese font at 13-15 pt, and is black or dark gray.

+1: Upper-right dashed box on slide 1: positioned above the laptop, within 25.2cm–31.4cm from the left and 3.4cm–5.2cm from the top. It is a blue dashed rounded rectangle 1 pt–1.5 pt wide, with a white fill or no fill, 5.2cm-5.6cm wide and 1.3cm-1.7cm high. The text inside reads “Data Analysis and Visualization,” uses SimHei, Microsoft YaHei, or a similar Chinese font at 18 pt–24 pt, and is dark blue. Below the “Data Analysis and Visualization” dashed box and above the upper edge of the laptop, within 27.5cm–28.8cm from the left and 4.8cm–6.7cm from the top, there is a blue vertical dashed single-headed arrow 1 pt–1.5 pt wide, pointing downward, with its tip pointing toward the laptop.

+1: Outer border of the bottom legend on slide 1: positioned within 3.6cm–30.3cm from the left and 15.3cm–18.2cm from the top. It is a blue dashed rounded rectangle 26cm–27cm wide and 2.2cm–2.5cm high, with a white fill or no fill and a blue dashed outline 1 pt–1.5 pt wide.

+1: Black line segment in the bottom legend on slide 1: positioned in the upper-left portion of the outer legend box, within 4.4cm–6.1cm from the left and 16cm–16.7cm from the top. It is a black horizontal single solid line 0.9cm–1.5cm long and 1.5 pt–2.5 pt wide. To the right of the black line segment, within 6cm–12.2cm from the left and 16cm–16.7cm from the top, the text reads “Working-Electrode Connector Line (Signal Output),” uses SimHei, Microsoft YaHei, or a similar Chinese font at 11 pt–13 pt, and is black or dark gray.

+1: Green line segment in the bottom legend on slide 1: positioned in the lower-left portion of the outer legend box, within 4.4cm–6.1cm from the left and 16.5cm–17.8cm from the top. It is a green horizontal single solid line 0.9cm–1.5cm long and 1.5 pt–2.5 pt wide. To the right of the green line segment, within 6cm–12.2cm from the left and 16.5cm–17.8cm from the top, the text reads “Reference-Electrode Connector Line (Potential Reference),” uses SimHei, Microsoft YaHei, or a similar Chinese font at 11 pt–13 pt, and is black or dark gray.

+1: Red line segment in the bottom legend on slide 1: positioned slightly right of center in the outer legend box, within 14.0cm–16cm from the left and 16cm–17cm from the top. It is a red horizontal single solid line 0.9cm–1.5cm long and 1.5 pt–2.5 pt wide. To the right of the red line segment, within 15.8cm–21.4cm from the left and 16cm–17cm from the top, the text reads “Counter-Electrode Connector Line (Current Path),” uses SimHei, Microsoft YaHei, or a similar Chinese font at 11 pt–13 pt, and is black or dark gray.

+1: Blue dashed arrow in the bottom legend on slide 1: positioned on the right side of the outer legend box, within 23.2cm–25cm from the left and 16.4cm–17.1cm from the top. It is a blue horizontal dashed single-headed arrow 1 pt–1.5 pt wide, pointing right. To the right of the blue dashed arrow, within 24.9cm–29.3cm from the left and 16.4cm–17.1cm from the top, the text reads “Signal/Control/Data Flow,” uses SimHei, Microsoft YaHei, or a similar Chinese font at 11-13 pt, and is black or dark gray.

+3: Overall layout of slide 1: the outer blue border, left-side beaker and three electrodes, three colored connector lines, electrochemical analyzer in the middle, laptop on the right, three blue dashed annotation boxes at the top and middle, bottom legend box, and its four legend groups all lie within the visible slide area. No text extends beyond its corresponding box, and no major graphics overlap noticeably in a way that makes them unreadable.
